The '''E-15 blaster rifle''' was a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] used by some [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].

==History==
By [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]], the E-15 had succeeded the [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]], though how widely it replaced the older model was unknown. By that year the E-15 had also been succeeded by the [[E-19 blaster rifle]].
